sources.short_excerpt: At each step the model is auto-regressive ... consuming the previously generated symbols as additional input when generating the next. ... This masking, combined with fact that the output embeddings are offset by one position, ensures that the predictions for position i can depend only on the known outputs at positions less than i.

sources.version: PyTorch 2.14 documentation; HTML title/llm:version=2.14; source link v2.14.0
sources.locator: CrossEntropyLoss class-index unreduced formula and Parameters: ignore_index; HTML lines 3798–3810, 3858–3861
sources.short_excerpt: ignore_index (int, optional) – Specifies a target value that is ignored and does not contribute to the input gradient. When size_average is True, the loss is averaged over non-ignored targets. Note that ignore_index is only applicable when the target contains class indices.
sources.inspection: 實讀 logits/target 說明、class-index 逐樣本公式及 ignore_index 參數。公式是同一 n 的 logits 與 target 比較；ignored label 不計 loss，也不貢獻該 logits 的梯度。此規則不是切除輸入。官方 stable 僅是 HTML redirect；已另外取得明確 2.14 URL。

sources.locator: torch.nonzero, as_tuple=False description and lexicographic ordering
sources.short_excerpt: Returns a tensor containing the indices of all non-zero elements of input. Each row in the result contains the indices of a non-zero element in input. The result is sorted lexicographically, with the last index changing the fastest (C-style).
sources.inspection: 實讀預設 as_tuple=False 回傳二維索引矩陣、維度為 z×n、字典序規則。對此處一維 bool y!=-100，第一列只有一個索引，因此 [0].item() 可取首有效格。未宣稱此寫法可直接套在一般二維 batch。
